pdf.js 4.10.38 (legacy build), by Mozilla, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Used to draw the first page of a PDF manual and to read manuals inside game-sauce. Bundled so it works without the internet.
The files are the unchanged pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs of the npm package pdfjs-dist, renamed to .js so every web server sends them as JavaScript.
